κηρύσσω.sd: to herald (as a public crier), especially divine truth (the gospel)
κηρύσσω.as:
κηρύσσω,
[in LXX chiefly for קרא;]
to be a herald, to proclaim: Mk 1:457:36, Lk 4:18, 19(LXX) (but v. Field, Notes, 174) 8:39, Ro 2:21, I Co 9:27, Ga 5:11, al.; in NT, chiefly of the proclamation of the Gospel, to proclaim, preach: τὸ εὐαγέλιον, Mt 4:239:3524:1426:13, Mk 1:1413:1014:916:[15], Ga 2:2, Col 1:23, I Th 2:9; seq. εἰς, Mk 1:3913:10, Lk 4:44, I Th 2:9; ἵνα, Mk 6:12; c. inf., Ro 2:21; κ. Χριστόν, Ἰησοῦν, Ac 8:59:2019:13, I Co 1:2315:12, II Co 1:1911:4, Phl 1:15; I Ti 3:16 (cf. προ-κηρύσσω).

κῆτος.long: a sea monster, huge sea fish, whale.
κῆτος.sd: a huge fish (as gaping for prey)
κῆτος.der: probably from the base of G5490 (χάσμα);
κῆτος.as:
κῆτος, -εος (-ους), τό,
[in LXX: Jh 2:1, 11 (דָּג), Ge 1:21 (תַּנִּין), etc.;]
a huge fish, sea-monster: Mt 12:40(LXX).†

κήρυγμα.sd: a proclamation (especially of the gospel; by implication, the gospel itself)
κήρυγμα.as:
κήρυγμα, -τος, τό
(< κηρύσσω), [in LXX: II Ch 30:5 (קוֹל), Jh 3.2 (קְרִיאָה), Pr 9:3, I Es 9:3*;]
in cl., that which is cried by a herald, a proclamation. In NT (v. Lft., Notes, 161), of God's heralds, proclamation, message, preaching (i.e. the substance as distinct from the act which would be expressed by † κήρυξις): Mt 12:41, Lk 11:32, I Co 1:21, II Ti 4:17, Tit 1:3; c. gen. subjc., τὸ κ. μου, I Co 2:4; ἡμῶν, I Co 15:14; c. gen. obj., Ἰησοῦ Χρ., Ro 16:25.†

κῆνσος.sd: properly, an enrollment ("census"), i.e. (by implication) a tax
κῆνσος.as:
*† κῆνσος, -ου, ὁ (Lat. census),
a poll-tax: Mt 17:2522:17, Mk 12:14 (WH, mg., ἐπικεφάλαιον); τ. νόμισμα τοῦ κ., Mt 22:19 (v. MM, Exp., xv).†
SYN:: τέλος (q.v.), φόρος.

κῆπος.long: a garden, any place planted with trees and herbs.
κῆπος.as:
κῆπος, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX for גַּן, גִּנָּה, גַּנָּה, De 11:10, Ca 4:12, al.;]
a garden: Lk 13:19, Jo 18:1, 2619:41.†

Κηφᾶς.long: Cephas (Aramaic for rock), the new name given to Simon Peter, the apostle.
Κηφᾶς.sd: the Rock; Cephas (i.e. Kepha), a surname of Peter
Κηφᾶς.as:
Κηφᾶς, -ᾶ (v. Bl., § 10, 3), ὁ (Aram. כֵּיפָא),
Cephas, i.e. Peter: Jo 1:43, I Co 1:123:229:515:5, Ga 1:182:9, 11, 14.†

κηπουρός.as:
* κηπ-ουρός, -οῦ, ὁ
(< κῆπος + οὖρος, a watcher),
a gardener: Jo 20:15.†

κημόω.as:
* κημόω, -ῶ
(< κημός, a muzzle),
to muzzle: I Co 9:9 (TTr., WH, mg.) (cf. φιμόω).†

κῆρυξ.sd: a herald, i.e. of divine truth (especially of the gospel)
κῆρυξ.as:
κῆρυξ
(κήρ-, T), -υκος, ὁ, [in LXX: Da LXX TH 3:4 (כָּרוֹז), Ge 41:43, Si 20:15, IV Mac 6:4*;]
a herald: I Ti 2:7, II Ti 1:11, II Pe 2:5.†
